card.name: Dosing frequency words after every/once
card.fires_on: The time unit that ends a dosing interval, such as hours after 'every 12' or daily/week after 'once', in dose-increase instructions. It also fires weakly on a few other words in the middle of phrases.

modes.label: Interval unit
modes.description: Hours, daily or week completing a frequency phrase like 'every 12 hours' or 'once daily'.
modes.example: increase dose to 150 mcg every 12<< hours>>. ( 2.3 ) Conversion

modes.label: Other stray words
modes.description: Occasional non-dosing words partway through a phrase, such as after re- or 'stands for'.
modes.example: comes up for re<<authorization>> too often
